The '''HCVw A9 turbo tank''', also called simply a '''Juggernaut''', was a model of large, ten-wheeled [[tank]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]]. Part of [[Kuat Drive Yards]]' line of armored, wheeled combat vehicles, it acted as the successor to the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]'s [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut]]. The Empire used the turbo tank throughout the [[Imperial Era]] as a [[troop carrier]] and [[transport]].

==Description==
[[File:HCVwA9TurboTank-TRF.jpg|thumb|left|230px|An HCVw A9 turbo tank as illustrated in ''The Rebel Files''.]]
The HCVw A9 turbo tank was part of a line of wheeled armored [[tank]]s manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> including its larger predecessor, the [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut]], which was used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="UVG" /> It was designed primarily as an [[infantry fighting vehicle]], meant to carry troops into battle and protect them once deployed.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

Featuring lighter armament and armor than other turbo tanks, the HCVw A9, compensated with its higher speed and a hull optimized for deflecting energy bolts.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> Despite this design, Juggernauts were more than capable of crushing through fortifications and withstanding direct hits from light vehicle-launched [[projectile launcher|projectiles]].<ref name="Juggernaut" /> Structurally, it was divided into two sections; the large cargo area—which could be configured to hold either troops or [[prisoner]]s—was connected to the command deck by a flexible, reinforced joint.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

For weaponry, it boasted a pair of [[turret]]-mounted [[heavy repeating blaster]]s for anti-personnel use and dorsal rapid-fire rotary [[laser cannon]] turrets for [[anti-aircraft gun|anti-aerial]]<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> and anti-[[missile]] use. The vehicles was also equipped with four forward-mounted rapid-fire blasters and two retracting multi-tube [[guided missile|guided]] [[missile launcher]]s.<ref name="Juggernaut" /> HCVw A9s were rarely deployed alone, and instead played supporting roles in larger armored formations, alongside Juggernauts, walkers, and other fast assault vehicles.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

==History==
[[File:HCVw-A9-Starships-and-Speeders.png|thumb|left|250px|An HCVw in the Imperial Army.]]
The HCVw was used during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Devil's Deal trivia gallery">{{SW|url=devil-s-deal-trivia-gallery|text=Tech's Notes: "Devil's Deal" Trivia Gallery}}</ref>

In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="S1Date">{{TBBDate|S1}}</ref> an HCVw tank transported the prisoners [[Hera Syndulla]], [[Gobi Glie]], and [[Serin]] to the [[Imperial Refinery]] on [[Ryloth]] after being arrested for smuggling weapons into the planet. This tank was also carrying Vice Admiral [[Edmon Rampart]], Senator [[Orn Free Taa]], as well as Captain [[Howzer]] who was guarding the two, and escorted by four [[BARC speeder]]s. [[Cham Syndulla]], [[Eleni Syndulla]] and members of [[Free Ryloth Movement]] attacked the convoy to rescue the trio of prisoners prompting Rampart to order reinforcements to be sent to assist the convoy. Their plea never got through, as [[Lenk]] had jammed their communications. The attempt ended with Hera's rescue, as she and her droid, [[C1-10P]] "Chopper," drove off on a speeder. Her rescue was at the expense of her liberators, who were captured by [[Clone trooper|clone stormtroopers]] on [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]]s. Rampart ordered Howzer and his men to sweep the area, adding that Hera would not get far.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />

[[File:A9_turbotank_S3-E12.png|thumb|280x280px|An A9 turbo tank firing its missiles in Erebus]]
HCVws were also used as prisoner transports in the [[Imperial labor camp]] on the [[planet]] [[Erebus]], where they ferried prisoners to and from the [[Imperial labor camp|mines]].<ref name="Juggernaut" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="S3Date">{{TBBDate|312}}</ref> [[Clone Force 99]] attacked [[Transport One (Juggernaut)|one such tank]] and commandeered it to extract Edmon Rampart, now a prisoner, from the facility. The turbo tank was attacked by [[Transport Two (Juggernaut)|another transport]] and LAATs dispatched by the [[prison]] [[Unidentified warden|warden]], but the rouge clones were able to fight them off. Their turbo tank was however disabled and they were forced to escape [[Erebus]] on board [[Phee Genoa]]'s ship, the ''[[Providence]]''.<ref name="Juggernaut" />

One HCVw A9 was used to transport [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Oolin Musters]], Imperial prisoners of [[Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817|Wobani Labor Camp]], to an unspecified location. En route, the A9 was [[Liberation of Erso|ambushed]] and the tank's lower entrance was breached by [[Rebel trooper]]s of [[Extraction Team Bravo]], who freed Erso from captivity.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The HCVw A9 turbo tank first appeared in [[Gareth Edwards]]' [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> It was identified in the corresponding [[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide|visual guide]] for the film on the same day.<ref name="UVG" /> It later appeared in multiple episodes of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Devil's Deal" /><ref name="Juggernaut" />

After the release of the ''The Bad Batch'' episode "[[Juggernaut (episode)|Juggernaut]]" on [[April 10]], [[2024]],<ref name="Juggernaut date">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/juggernaut-episode-guide|text="Juggernaut" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}}</ref> the entry for the [[HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport]] in the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]]<ref name="DB A9.2 old">{{Databank|juggernaut-transport-vehicle|Juggernaut transport vehicle|oldversion=20240815000000}}</ref> was updated to instead now feature an image of the HCVw A9 turbo tank from the episode, but no other information in the entry was changed.<ref name="DB A9.2 new">{{Databank|juggernaut-transport-vehicle|Juggernaut transport vehicle}}</ref>
